title: Breakthrough Technologies with 3D Systems at Formnext 2026
summary: Breakthrough Technologies with 3D Systems at Formnext 2026 Anna Daugherty Wed, 11/25/2026 - 10:26 3D Systems at Formnext 2026 Always an incredible opportunity to showcase the latest innovations from 3D Systems, Formnext 2026 was a success for our team as we highlighted breakthrough technologies, explored real-world production applications , and connected with other industry experts and enthusiasts. Take a look at what we presented during the tradeshow and learn more about how 3D Systems is helping companies unlock new levels of performance with additive manufacturing. New Technology and MJP Advancements During the event, 3D Systems announced the release of our new MJP 300 multijet 3D printer , our new TSR (Transport-Sieve-Reload) powder management systems for direct metal 3D printing , and upgrades to the 3D Sprint software including digital rights management (DRM) tools. Additionally, 3D Systems has released a new Industrial Wax Kit, enabling use of the VisiJet Wax Jewel Red material for industries such as aerospace due to being highly ductile, durable and flexible. With focused investments and strategies in aerospace & defense , healthcare and dental markets, 3D Systems is committed to delivering advanced tools and technologies to customers. Attendees at formnext were invited to our booth to see these new innovations up-close and ask our team additional questions about their capabilities. 40 Years of 3D Printing Marking the 40th anniversary of the founding of 3D Systems and 43 years of the invention of SLA 3D printing by co-founder Chuck Hull, an exclusive 40th Anniversary celebration for team members, partners, and customers was held in our formnext booth. A 3D-printed life-size SLA model of Chuck Hull was on display for the show and formnext attendees were able to hold the first 3D-printed part to immerse themselves in the origins of additive manufacturing. Next-Generation Innovations: ETH Zurich Hyperloop Model With a commitment to the future of additive manufacturing, attendees were invited to discover how pellet-based additive manufacturing is supporting the development of next-generation hyperloop technologies and unlocking new opportunities for large-format manufacturing applications. A hyperloop prototype model was hosted in our booth to help attendees visualize how ETH Zürich utilized our EXT Titan Pellet 3D printing technology for production of their hyperloop prototype, leading to six awards at the European Hyperloop Week 2026. Informative Sessions of the Industry's Latest Formnext attendees were able to take advantage of educational sessions on leading additive manufacturing initiatives! 3D Systems held 3 speaking sessions that were highly attended and engaging for audience members, 'The First Layer: From Rapid Prototyping to Additive Manufacturing and Beyond' with Chuck Hull, Co-founder & CTO, 3D Systems & Patrick Dunne, SVP & Technical Fellow, 3D Systems 'Direct Multi-Jet 3D Printing of Internally-Cooled Turbine Blade Patterns for Investment Casting' with Patrick Dunne, SVP & Technical Fellow, 3D Systems 'Advancing Hyperloop Innovation with Pellet-Based Additive Manufacturing' with André Metzger, Channel Sales Manager, 3D Systems & James Schatzmann, Mechanical Engineering Student, Swissloop/ETH Zürich After the sessions, attendees were invited to meet us at our booth to discuss these innovations further with our team members! Dental and Healthcare Innovations from 3D Systems With technologies from 3D Systems enabling major advancements in the dental and medtech industries, customers and partners were invited to discover more about our innovative selection of 3D-printing solutions to fit your needs, including the dental industry’s first multi-material, multi-shade monolithic jetted denture solution. Looking Ahead to 2027 From concept to production, we appreciated the opportunity to introduce our latest innovations and how they are driving the future of manufacturing. We appreciate all of the formnext attendees that made this year's show a success for 3D Systems! Our team members find valuable connections each year with customers and partners at this exciting event and we look forward to continuing these conversations into 2027. body_markdown:
Formnext attendees were able to take advantage of educational sessions on leading additive manufacturing initiatives! 3D Systems held 3 speaking sessions that were highly attended and engaging for audience members,


**'The First Layer: From Rapid Prototyping to Additive Manufacturing and Beyond'** with Chuck Hull, *Co-founder & CTO, 3D Systems* & Patrick Dunne, *SVP & Technical Fellow, 3D Systems*


**'Direct Multi-Jet 3D Printing of Internally-Cooled Turbine Blade Patterns for Investment Casting'** with Patrick Dunne, *SVP & Technical Fellow, 3D Systems*


**'Advancing Hyperloop Innovation with Pellet-Based Additive Manufacturing'** with André Metzger, *Channel Sales Manager, 3D Systems* & James Schatzmann, *Mechanical Engineering Student, Swissloop/ETH Zürich*


After the sessions, attendees were invited to meet us at our booth to discuss these innovations further with our team members!
